purpose: Freeze one source-cited uniform shell thickness for the BM-MESH M3 size-to-thickness observation without importing solver physics.

thicknessBasis.sourceValueStatement: The existing LAFEA.4 cylindricalSource fixture assigns thickness 1.5 to every generated shell element.
thicknessBasis.basisContractStatement: The LAFEA.4 thickness-basis contract recomputes source authority, requires positive element thickness, and rejects source-hash mismatch rather than accepting a naked injected thickness.
thicknessBasis.qualificationWitnessStatement: The existing TECH2 witness validates the basis as UNIFORM_THICKNESS and asserts uniformThickness, minimumThickness and maximumThickness are all 1.5.

sizeToThicknessQualification.note: The production gate reports WARNING outside the band; this artifact does not convert that warning into a BLOCK or alter production thresholds.

scopeBoundary: This fixture supplies only a uniform thickness scalar for M3 h/t mesh-quality observation on the frozen two-patch shell geometry. It is not a physical-analysis or solver fixture.
